messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PAGED: pagerduty triggered for embed-queue-throttle (P2). Alert: 5xx rate rising, error budget burn. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-queue-throttle

pagerbot: Page fired -> escalation policy: inference-tier2. Auto-ack window 120s. Notifying oncall.

morgan: Oncall here, seeing spike in embeddings pipeline errors. Re-routing traffic to dedicated pool now. :eyes:

alice: Are customers impacted? Got a ticket from Acme that their ingest is failing. Any ETA?

bob: I can take lead, joining bridge. Starting from logs to confirm root cause. bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident-6654321000

sre-oncall: Created temporary rule to drop low-priority retries to relieve queue. Patch applied, monitoring.

charlie: Quick hint — kv-cache eviction rate spiked in EU shard 3 minutes ago. Could be K/V pressure causing OOMs in worker pods.

morgan: Confirmed kubectl output shows repeated OOMKilled for embed-worker-*. Suspecting autoscaler thrash.

bob: Running quick checks:```bash
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embed-worker -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs embed-worker-7f9d -c worker | tail -n 50
```

alice: Customer impact: single large customer (Acme) reports 30% of ingests failed over last 10m. Others low rate but increased latency.

sre-oncall: Scaling policy adjusted to keep minReplicas=4 in eu region to stabilize. Will wait 2min before reverting.

bob: I'm on the bridge and will drive mitigation. morgan -> if you need to hand off, ping me now.

morgan: handing off to bob. I need to jump to another incident. Handoff at 18:22 UTC. :handshake:

bob: Ack takeover. Running heap dump and collecting kernel messages; posting results in 5.

charlie: Found correlated webhook backlog on the ingress side, looks like a surge from a misbehaving client. Throttle rule queued to block that client IP, applying now.

alice: Noted mitigation. I'll notify Acme support and share the temporary workaround (retry with 5s backoff).

bob: Post-mitigation check: error rate dropped from 42% -> 6% over 4m. Latency back to baseline for non-Acme tenants. Keeping page open until stable 10m window.

incidentbot: PAGE UPDATE: acked by bob. status: investigating -> mitigated (partial). next actions: follow-up runbook, RCA if recurring.

pagerbot: Reminder: if page persists or re-fires, escalate to infra-leads. Otherwise mark resolved after 30m quiet window.

charlie: Adding note: create follow-up ticket to tune autoscaler thresholds and add client-side rate limiting guidance.

alice: Thanks all. I'll send customer update and close support ticket once 30m quiet window completes. :thumbsup:
